questions: Are self-loops allowed when C_{i,i} is a letter, and if so, does a single self-loop edge form a palindrome path of length 1 from vertex i to itself?
If there is no path from i to j that forms a palindrome, what value should A_{i,j} be? (e.g., -1, 0, infinity, or something else)
Is a zero-length path (i=j with no edges) considered a palindrome path? If so, should its length be 0?
For a path that uses the same edge multiple times (cycles), are they allowed, and does the palindrome condition apply to the full concatenated label sequence?
If multiple edges exist between the same i and j (which is impossible per spec), but spec says exactly one directed edge if C_{i,j} is a letter, so this is not ambiguous.
Should the output for A_{i,i} (same start and end) always be 0 if empty path is a palindrome, or could it be longer if the shortest palindrome path is through a cycle?
Are uppercase letters allowed? The spec says lowercase English letters only, so this is clear.

If a path has length > 0 and its label concatenation is a palindrome, but a shorter path with the same start/end exists that is not a palindrome, should we still return the length of the palindrome path?
